application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Removal of existing polycarbonate roof on existing rear conservatory extension and replacement with a mono-pitch tiled roof and demolition of existing bay extension to the conservatory and new window arrangement to rear single-storey rear extension.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Unnumbered Location Plan, Unnumbered Block Plan, 124THORNBURYROAD 01, 124THORNBURYROAD OB 03, Received: 20/04/2021 ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
